result_text:
The "Undefined Team" now only collects active contributors. I compiled `codeanalyzer`, but I didn't run any tests. I didn't check whether any exist for this code.

The change is one condition in `getAllTeams()` in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/landscape/analysis/LandscapeAnalysisResults.java`. A contributor matched by no team is added to the remainder only if `contributor.getContributor().isActive()` is true.

- **Blank dates:** `DateUtils.isDateWithinRange` already returns true for a blank latest-commit date, so those contributors stay in.
- **Configured teams:** they still keep all their members.
